body:
[aida:product] STORY-1422 IS PR #2049. Pushed, mergeable, with the reviewer. Nothing waits on me.

    head            3acf3671fd
    fmt --check     clean
    full lib suite  5236 passed, 0 failed, exit 0 — read before the push
    mutations       7 of 7 red, each verified present in the file first; restored 8 green

WHAT IT DOES, in one line: `aida doctor check performance --fail-on-findings` turns a query that could not fail into a gate that can, and a scaffolded substrate job runs it on a cadence with a CronJobFailed-keyed seat job routing the trip to you.

DEMONSTRATED ON THE REAL STORE — this is criterion 2's non-zero half, and it is in the PR body:

    show = 1000   --fail-on-findings   exit 1   `aida show` exceeded its 1000 ms budget on
                                                20.2% of 5656 calls in 24h (tolerated 10.0%,
                                                worst 39363 ms)
    show = 1000   (no flag)            exit 0   the FLAG gates, not the category
    show = 99999  --fail-on-findings   exit 0   not always-fail
    shwo = 1000   --fail-on-findings   exit 1   the typo case is caught

THE MUTATION COUNT THAT MATTERS: "always trips" produced exactly 2 red — the post-fix population and the inside-window case. Those are the only two tests asserting the gate stays QUIET. A suite without them passes happily while a gate sits permanently red, which is the failure you caught in my 5% proposal. The count is evidence the negative controls exist rather than me asserting they do.

YOUR 10% IS IMPLEMENTED AS PROVISIONAL, with the reasoning in the code rather than only on the spec: trips today at 20.2% with 2x margin, clears an estimated 7.1% post-fix residual with 1.4x, and the 1s-4s band's survival is unknown. The rejected 5% is PINNED IN A TEST asserting it would have tripped on the post-fix population — so re-tightening is a deliberate act with the consequence in front of whoever does it.

WHAT IS STILL OPEN AND IS NOT MINE TO CLOSE:
    criterion 2 zero half    needs the fixed tree — blocked on #2033 by construction
    criterion 7 re-measure   same blocker, same reason
    criterion 4 end-to-end   the chain is scaffolded and each link verified separately;
                             a live trip through tick -> CronJobFailed -> awaiting has not
                             been run, because the substrate job ships DISABLED

That last one I want to be exact about rather than let it read as done: I verified the event exists and is emitted on substrate-job failure, and I verified the gate exits non-zero. I have NOT watched a tick fire the chain end to end. Saying "ledgered and routed" is satisfied would be an inference, and inferences about whether an instrument fires are what this spec exists to stop.

INDEPENDENCE HOLDS: I implemented it, the reviewer reviews it, you merge. I am not merging #2049 and I am not merging #2033.

NEXT ON MY LIST unless you redirect: #1974, then #1981, as assigned.
subject: STORY-1422 is PR #2049 — 5236 tests green, 7/7 mutations red, gate demonstrated on the real store; criterion 4 end-to-end NOT claimed
